eval: (()=>{const g=__game,V=g.THREE.Vector3; const res={}; for(const n of [30,300]){ g.step(n,1/60,false); g.eagle.object.updateMatrixWorld(true); for(const nm of ['rectrices','contour-feathers','trouser-feathers','flight-feathers']){ let m=null; g.eagle.object.traverse(o=>{ if(o.name===nm) m=o;}); if(!m){res[nm]='?';continue;} m.skeleton.update(); const P=m.geometry.attributes.position; let worst=9,v=new V(); for(let i=0;i<P.count;i+=3){ m.getVertexPosition(i,v); m.localToWorld(v); worst=Math.min(worst,v.y-g.terrainHeight(v.x,v.z)); } res[nm+n]=worst.toFixed(3);} } return res})()
